name: XXL-JOB Console
description: Manage XXL-JOB tasks, logs and executors with DBX built-in AI and MCP, DBX-managed tool access and confirmed operation previews.
releaseNotes: 0.4.4 makes DBX the single source of MCP authorization: the plugin-side AI/MCP switch and per-connection tool allowlist are removed, while manifest-declared tools and preview-confirmed writes remain. External MCP grants, access ceilings, tool opt-outs and connection scope are managed in DBX Settings → MCP → Capabilities. Also includes declared access for all 22 tools, keyboard-searchable executor dropdowns, and inherited executor filters. Requires DBX 0.6.60+ and Host API ^1.4.0.
